pe_prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Hyper-realistic stop-motion food animation, choppy beat-synced cadence, a static eye-level shot opens exactly on <Picture 1>: the empty white marble island with grey veining in the foreground, warm oak-toned shaker cabinets, stainless built-in ovens, and soft warm diffused daylight from the window, with no people, hands, or creatures anywhere. In stop-motion steps synced to tick sounds, a 40×30cm bamboo cutting board with clear natural grain, a 20cm matte stainless mixing bowl, two fresh textured eggs, a milk pitcher, cream, and a small sugar bowl settle onto the island one by one, each item landing firmly in place. The eggs crack open by themselves with a crisp snap; yolks and whites drop in steady streams into the bowl with soft plops, the shells split and fly off to both sides then vanish; milk, cream, and fine white sugar pour in measured additions, and a whisk stirs the mixture at constant speed with even metallic friction. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a macro close-up with stable framing: a fine stainless sieve sits above the matte stainless spouted measuring cup with black graduation marks, and custard flows through the mesh in a smooth thin stream with a fine hissing sound, bubbles and impurities caught in the mesh; the beat ends on a sharp freeze frame. [Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts back to the medium shot: a 30×20cm black matte cast-iron baking pan lands on the island, a fitted sheet of food-grade parchment paper settles into it with a soft paper sound, then frosted frozen tart shells place themselves one by one into the pan in an evenly spaced, neatly aligned grid, each placement with a light click; the final beat ends on a crisp, sharp freeze frame of the neatly filled pan, with lighting, prop positions, and the background kitchen identical to <Picture 1> throughout, no brightness jumps, no clipping, floating, or teleporting.

overall_soundscape: Stop-motion tick sounds mark each prop landing, followed by the crisp crack of eggs, liquid plops into the bowl, the soft whoosh of eggshells flying off, steady metallic stirring friction, the fine hiss of custard straining through the sieve, the soft rustle of parchment paper, and light clicks as each tart shell settles into the pan, all strictly synced to the on-screen motion.
